title: SQUARE: A Large-Scale Dataset of Sensitive Questions and Acceptable Responses Created Through Human-Machine Collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to socially sensitive and contentious questions to determine if they are inclusive and respect the diversity of social groups, using human evaluation and a trained Acceptable Response Classifier.
Assessing whether models commit to a specific stance on divisive issues or maintain inclusivity of diverse opinions via human annotation and filter-based moderation.
